did: Studio's Renders page no longer drops an essay home is owed once its Monday passes. It stays under Coming as overdue and says what it waits on: a take home couldn't hear or hasn't heard yet, a week not made final, a refused essay, or nothing written. The weekly call's next week works the same way, and its expected day, which had been a week early, now falls the Friday after the newest week ends. Three new alerts, RustEssayOverdue, InterviewEssayOverdue and CallWeekOverdue, fire for an owed essay or week that never arrived, whatever the cause, so a Monday routine that never ran is heard of. The README names where home's database lives and how to read it read-only.

calls.title: How long an overdue essay stays on the board
options: Keep reading the newest two weeks, so an owed essay drops a week after its Monday
Read the newest four weeks, so it stays about three weeks, bounded
calls.why: Three weeks of a visible row and an alert is loud enough, and the read stays one bounded read, as every pass's must. What happens past the bound is server#1156.

calls.title: Whether the essays' overdue alert or the routine watch hears a Monday routine that never ran
options: Add the Rust Rounds and interview routines to routine_watch
Let the overdue alert on the essay they owe cover it, whatever the cause
calls.why: Those routines may not write the run records routine_watch reads, and the outcome the owner cares about is the essay, which the alert covers for every cause.
calls.undo: Add the routines to routine_watch.rs once they write run records.

left: Past the bound, about three weeks for an essay and ACTIVE_DAYS for the call, an overdue row and its alert end as if the episode came. The coordinator kept the bounds; server#1156 proposes the row turn missed instead.
The phone's words for overdue and waitsOn, and EV3's ledger lines, are some-ui's, in some-ui#3488 and with a some-ui worker.
A stray branch, fix/renders-owed-overdue, with no pull request, stays because deleting it was refused; the coordinator is raising it with the owner.
